scripts.check: pnpm lint && pnpm generate && pnpm generated:fresh && pnpm --filter @spotarr/contract breaking && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test
scripts.generated:fresh: test -z "$(git status --porcelain -- ':(glob)**/gen/**')" || { echo 'Generated code is stale: run pnpm generate and commit the result.'; exit 1; }
